$comment: COMEDOR, 2026-11-08. Chandeliers lift out as hanging props (the salon's route). Room life at full party: props with minTier only wake at the top tiers. pulse = frame 0 is rest, the last is the peak, reached on the beat (shifted by phaseBeats); sway = rest in the middle. Warped props bend the painting's own pixels about a pivot; drawn props (drawn.images) are Qwen edits of a small box, cut to the polygon. fillOnly props are painted out of the plate and never drawn: the near-side chairs (so diners can sit behind the table) and two orange lamp discs the guide left on the wall.

drawn.prompt: Image 1 is part of a pixel art painting: an old oil portrait in a gilt frame of a gentleman in a dark coat with his hands folded at his waist. Draw exactly the same picture, the same gentleman, frame and colours at the same place and size, and change only his hands: they are no longer folded. His hand on the right of the picture rests alone at his waist, and his hand on the left of the picture is raised beside his shoulder, snapping its fingers, the thumb and middle finger pressed together. He has exactly two hands.

props.$comment: First pair (78200, 78201) raised a hand but kept both folded hands at the waist: three hands. Redrawn with the hands named one by one (78300...).
The near chairs' legs and the Qwen fills' damask patterns made the cloth patchy, so the whole front is one clean strip of the painted cloth (between the fourth and fifth chairs) tiled across.
